name: Yuvraaj Bhatter
tagline: I build small, weird, delightful software — like a brain that grows out of your habits.
bio:
I like making things.

Sometimes that means building software, sometimes it means figuring out why a piece of hardware works, and sometimes it means sitting at a piano trying to figure out a specific arpeggio.

I’m interested in software engineering, product, and the space where technology meets creativity. I enjoy working through complex problems and building useful, well-designed software.

Still learning, still experimenting, and always looking for the next thing worth building.
bioShort: Software developer. Currently growing a digital brain out of daily habits.
